projectDescription: A full-stack IT help desk ticketing system built with ASP.NET Core MVC and Supabase, enabling employees to submit support tickets and technicians to manage, triage, and resolve them through a role-based workflow.
keyFeatures: Role-based access control with three roles: EMPLEADO (employee), SOPORTE (support technician), and SUPERUSUARIO (super admin)
Ticket lifecycle management with a strict state transition workflow (PENDIENTE → EN PROCESO → EN REVISIÓN → RESUELTO / CANCELADO)
Automatic ticket assignment to the least-busy available support technician
Multi-file attachment support stored in Supabase Storage (ticket-files bucket)
Threaded comment system on tickets with per-user edit/delete permissions
Analytics dashboard with Chart.js bar chart showing tickets by priority, powered by EF Core
User profile management with photo upload to Supabase Storage (profile-photos bucket)
Advanced ticket filtering by user, date range, state, and system
Super admin user role management panel (SUPERUSUARIO-only)
Supabase Auth integration for registration, login, logout, and password change
publicApiSurface: GET /Tickets — List and filter tickets (role-scoped)
GET /Tickets/Create — New ticket form (EMPLEADO, SUPERUSUARIO only)
POST /Tickets/Create — Submit a new ticket
GET /Tickets/Edit/{id} — View/edit a ticket with comments
POST /Tickets/Edit/{id} — Update ticket fields
POST /Tickets/UpdateState — Advance ticket state in workflow
POST /Tickets/AddComment — Add a comment to a ticket
POST /Tickets/UpdateComment — Edit an existing comment (owner only)
POST /Tickets/DeleteComment — Delete a comment (owner only)
POST /Tickets/DeleteAttachment — Remove an attachment from storage and DB
GET /Account/Login — Login page
POST /Account/Login — Authenticate with Supabase
GET /Account/Register — Registration page
POST /Account/Register — Create new account via Supabase Auth
GET /Account/Logout — Sign out and clear session
GET /Users/Profile — View current user profile
POST /Users/Profile — Update name, photo, or password
GET /Users/Index — Admin user list (SUPERUSUARIO only)
POST /Users/CambiarRol — Change a user's role (SUPERUSUARIO only)
GET /Home/Dashboard — Priority analytics dashboard (SOPORTE, SUPERUSUARIO only)
ITicketService.GetTicketsAsync(userId, userRole, filters) — Role-aware ticket retrieval
ITicketService.CreateTicketAsync(model, requesterId) — Creates ticket with auto-assignment
ITicketService.UpdateTicketStateAsync(ticketId, newStateId, userId, userRole) — Enforces state machine transitions
StorageService.UploadProfilePhoto(userId, photo, accessToken, refreshToken) — Upload to profile-photos bucket
